title: Rig Relay Bridge Message v1
description: Canonical bidirectional bridge protocol envelope for Rig Relay WebSocket. No tokens, API keys, OAuth codes, raw prompts, or private file contents.

message_id.description: Unique per-message identifier. Format: msg_<12hex>. Server and client each maintain their own namespace.

handshake_id.description: Session-scoped correlation ID. Format: corr_<12hex> (backend) or hs_<12hex> (frontend fallback).

sequence.description: Monotonic per-sender-per-connection sequence number. Gaps indicate dropped messages.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of message creation.

requires_ack.description: When true, receiver must respond with an ack (kind=lifecycle_event with ack_for=message_id).

ack_for.description: When present, this message acknowledges the message with this message_id.

idempotency_key.description: When present, duplicate messages with the same idempotency_key must not execute twice. Format: idem_<intent_id_or_hash>.

projection_sequence.description: Monotonic projection sequence number. Frontend ignores messages with sequence <= last_rendered.

payload_schema.description: Optional schema identifier for the payload field (e.g., 'rig.relay.desktop_projection.v1').

payload.description: Kind-specific data. Must be content-light: no tokens, keys, codes, prompts, or file contents.

safe_summary.description: Content-light summary for evidence/telemetry. Never contains raw content. Example: {intent_name: 'refresh_projection', status: 'succeeded'}.

redaction_status.description: Hard invariant: every envelope is content_light.
